prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: neck and back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1491; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of side impact at intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on the driver side by a vehicle that entered on a red signal, per insured's statement. Police report requested. Scene photos received from insured and placed in file.

Entry 2: Claimant notified carrier that he is represented by counsel. All further contact to be routed through attorney's office. Acknowledgment letter sent to counsel. Claimant reports neck and back strain treated at urgent care; medical records requested under signed authorization from counsel.

Entry 3: Other driver's carrier contacted to confirm liability position. Carrier disputes fault and cites a possible late yellow light. Reviewed intersection traffic camera request status; footage retention window noted as limited, follow-up scheduled to confirm preservation.

Entry 4: Counsel's office provided initial treatment summary showing cervical and lumbar strain with prescribed physical therapy. No surgical recommendation at this time. Treatment plan and provider notes added to file. Reserve review flagged for supervisor sign-off.

Entry 5: Witness statement obtained from a pedestrian present at the intersection, supporting insured's account of the signal phase. Physical therapy progress requested from counsel. File remains open pending medical updates and liability determination.
